# MedZo — Medical Practice Management for Australian Clinics

MedZo provides end-to-end medical practice management services across Australia.
We handle billing, Medicare compliance, scheduling, virtual reception, and
healthcare administration so GPs, specialists, allied health, and dental clinics
can focus on patient care.

## Who we serve

- General Practitioners (GPs) and GP clinics
- Medical specialists
- Allied health practices (physiotherapy, psychology, occupational therapy)
- Dental clinics
- Multidisciplinary clinics
- Telehealth providers

## Services

- Medical Billing and Medicare Claims: end-to-end billing management, Medicare bulk billing, private health fund claims, and revenue cycle optimisation
- Compliance and Accreditation: RACGP, AGPAL, and healthcare regulatory compliance support
- Virtual Reception: professional phone answering, appointment booking, and patient communication
- Practice Scheduling and Operations: diary management, workflow optimisation, and day-to-day administrative support
- Recruitment: healthcare-specific staff sourcing for clinical and administrative roles across Australia

## Why practices choose MedZo

- Dedicated healthcare administration specialists — not a generic outsourcing provider
- Deep knowledge of Australian Medicare, DVA, and private health billing rules
- Scalable support that grows with the practice
- Reduces administrative overhead and billing errors
- Lets clinical staff focus on patient care instead of paperwork

## Location and availability

Australian-owned and operated. Serving medical practices nationally across all states and territories.
